note: The bands the Radian plant has to land in, from docs/GLIDER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the E-flite Radian and Radian Pro (scripts/glider-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

g1_glide.source: L/D power off, the prop folded, at 8 m/s, derived 18.7 (best 18.9 at 7.5); a Radian's glide is well over 15

g2_min_sink.source: power off, the least sink over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 0.379 at 7.1 m/s

g3_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 6.49; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.05 / 5.709, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 5.336 (scripts/glider-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.709: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.18391. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.050 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.072, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.050 / 1.122) = 0.9676.

g4_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 9.59 at 15.2 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 5.81 at 11.6 m/s on the straight line, which under-read the thrust at speed; the band the same 0.69 to 1.19 of the derived (was 4.0 to 6.9), and the sweep moved with the best climb speed it brackets (was 9 to 14 m/s) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 8.93 at 15.09 m/s, was 9.59 at 15.19; the same 0.688 to 1.188 of it.

g5_level.source: level at 65 percent throttle, derived 17.14. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 14.05 on the straight line; the band the same 0.868 to 1.153 of the derived (was 12.2 to 16.2) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 18.78, was 17.14; the same 0.868 to 1.153 of it.

g6_roll.source: full aileron from level at 65 percent: the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.111, 77 deg/s at 12 m/s

g7_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

g8_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 17.8, the wind from the left

g9_yaw_rate.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 115 at the 17.14 m/s that holds. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the 65 percent speed rose, so the rate with it, was 94 at 14.05 m/s; the band the same 0.67 to 1.49 of the derived (was 63 to 140) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share (the 65 percent speed rose, 18.78 m/s, was 17.14, and the rate with it): derived 125.7, was 114.7; the same 0.671 to 1.491 of it.

g10_rudder_roll.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from the polyhedral; steady roll rate derived 70 deg/s at 17.14 m/s once the sideslip is built, about 106 deg by 2 s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the 65 percent speed rose and the roll rate goes with V, was 58 deg/s at 14.05 m/s, about 87 deg by 2 s; the band the same 0.345 to 1.38 of the derived (was 30 to 120) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share (the 65 percent speed rose, 18.78 m/s, was 17.14, and the roll rate with it): derived 77.2 deg/s, was 70.4; the same 0.526 to 2.074 of it.

g11_fold.source: at 8 m/s: folded under 5 percent throttle, no thrust and nothing turning; open at 5 percent the prop brakes by -Ts d^2 ct(V / (Vp d)), the curve carried on along its last two tenths past mu 2 as the plant does, derived 0.128 N. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 0.106 N on the straight line Ts d^2 (V / (Vp d) - 1); the band the same 0.566 to 1.51 of the derived (was 0.06 to 0.16) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the 5 percent stick turning the open prop faster: derived 0.149 N, was 0.128; the same 0.562 to 1.508 of it.

g12_glide_open.source: L/D at 8 m/s with the prop open at 5 percent, derived 14.96 against 18.7 folded. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the open prop brakes harder on the curve, was 15.5; the band the same 0.839 to 1.148 of the derived (was 13.0 to 17.8) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share (the open prop at 5 percent turns faster on the seated pack and brakes harder): derived 14.49, was 14.96; the same 0.839 to 1.148 of it.

g13_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.092, 80 percent of the measured electrical power 0.225 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived the static figures times the speed share squared the gates' pack turns the prop at standing, 0.987^2 = 0.974 (Model Aviation's 11.51 V a fresh pack's, the 4.1 V pack a little under it): ideal disc power 0.090, was 0.092; the same 0.080 to 0.240 of it.

g14_thermal.source: circling at 30 deg and 8.5 m/s centred on the 2.5 m/s thermal: rise at 12.8 m, 2.11, less the turn's sink, 0.52, derived 1.59

g15_still.source: the same circle where the air is still: the turn's sink, derived 0.52

g16_topped.source: the same circle over the thermal's top, 300 m: the still air's sink again

g17_throw.source: the shell's throw, 10 m/s, at 70 percent, for two seconds the stick that trims a 10 m/s climb there (5.2 deg of elevator through the expo; neutral trims the 7.7 m/s glide): airborne and flying after three. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the climb at 70 percent steepens from 10.2 to 18.5 deg, was -0.274, 4.8 deg Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), the stick through the motor's law: the climb at 70 percent steepens to 21.4 deg, was 17.5; the stick that holds it -0.306, was -0.294, 5.44 deg.

g18_chop.source: throttle off from level at 65 percent, the pitch stick left where level flight had it: a glide, not a tumble

g19_phugoid.source: from level at 65 percent, hands off at the same throttle: the elevator neutral trims a 7.2 m/s climb at 18 deg, whose phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model is 5.73 s, zeta -0.005; a glider's phugoid is long and barely damped, zeta near 1/(sqrt 2 L/D). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was a 7.4 m/s climb at 11 deg, 5.64 s, zeta 0.071; the band the same 0.816 to 1.170 of the derived (was 4.6 to 6.6). The steeper climb takes the damping to neutral, so the plant's swing is large Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 5.89 s hands off at 65 percent, a 6.98 m/s climb at 22 deg, was 5.73; the same 0.815 to 1.171 of it.

g20_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's, the Skyhunter's and the Cub's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Radian existed; the Radian must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

g21_cross_host.source: the Radian's recorded climb, glide and thermal, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 10 m/s, 100 m up, 0.5 throttle, every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 6.13 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.008 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 6.13 m), the bank within 0.001 deg and the heading within 0.003 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.004 m of the derived 4.21. Held within 0.03 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 11.8 m/s, the plant 11.78, within 0.014 along the curve, held within 0.04.

stab_straight_acro.source: thrown level at 12 m/s, 100 m up, 0.5 throttle, every stick centred in Acro (plant_wing.c acro_sticks: the attitude held where it was thrown): the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Acro's attitude hold: derived 2.36 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.003 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 2.36 m), the bank within 0.001 deg and the heading within 0.002 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.002 m of the derived 1.76. Held within 0.02 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 13.06 m/s, the plant 13.05, within 0.013 along the curve, held within 0.04.
